name: Iron Current
look: a sleek robot Suicune of glassy teal with pale diamond facets, a lavender hood of plates, a glowing pink hexagon crest and four arching tendrils of starry pink light
entry: A Pokémon resembling Suicune, sketched in a report about a light that ran along a river at night and left the water crystal clear. Its tendrils of light purify anything they touch.
how: Wild: very rare at night by rivers, lakes and beaches.
